en.name: Side step
en.subtitle: Teacher-marked movement · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand facing the camera. Check that there is clear space on both sides.
Take one small step sideways, keeping your chest facing forward.
Bring your other foot towards it without crossing your feet. Pause with both feet down.
Take a small step back the other way.
Bring the other foot in and pause. Move side to side without jumping.
en.focus: Teacher marks each sideways step-and-close as one attempt. Keep the full movement in frame.

zh-Hant.name: 側步
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師記錄動作 · 小一至小三
steps: 面向鏡頭站立，確定左右兩邊有空間。
向旁邊踏一小步，胸口保持向前。
另一隻腳跟近，不要交叉雙腳，雙腳落地後稍停。
另一隻腳跟近後稍停，左右移動，不要跳躍。
zh-Hant.focus: 老師把每次側踏及跟近記作一次，讓整段動作保持在畫面內。
